items.title: Meta’s Muse just changed the AI game
items.summary: Is Meta finally catching up to OpenAI and Anthropic? In The Loop host Ejaaz Ahamadeen heads to Qualcomm's Snapdragon Summit in Maui to break down Meta's Muse: the AI model suddenly turning heads across the industry as a serious contender in the AI race. Then, Ejaaz sits down with Qualcomm CFO & COO Akash Palkhiwala for an inside look at how the chip giant is betting big on agentic AI, straight from one of tech's biggest stages.

items.title: Muse AI Is Already Forcing Tough Choices for Retailers. Amazon Isn’t Immune.
items.summary: Meta Platforms  may have the first breakout winner with consumers in its Muse AI agent.  If it keeps up the momentum, Muse is going to force website owners to make some difficult decisions about how much access they are willing to allow it, if any.  Personal agents released earlier this year like OpenClaw proved too complex for most people.
